recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for FHIR core. No core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-23003; any future revisit of ex-diagnosis-on-admission terminology should be handled separately in THO/UTG rather than under this narrowed core issue.
issue_request: FHIR-23003 is Applied/Persuasive with Modification for Financial Management. It originally raised IP concerns about both ex-revenue-center and ex-diagnosis-on-admission example CodeSystems, but the final 2022 comments narrow application to ex-revenue-center only and the resolution is to change ex-revenue codes to made-up values.
initial_application: The issue was initially applied in core by f7b4d814e29d2372185b3e61f528fe8a57e11305, which replaced the historical revenue-center concepts with three example concepts and also changed diagnosis-on-admission under the earlier broader resolution. Commit 5c0494aacfd0b8bd52bc72c587aa89d0a64246f8 later removed both CodeSystem source files from core as part of UTG content removal.
additional_context: FHIR-22116 is an earlier same-family NUBC attribution issue; its comment says the codes in question were removed. Current fhir.ini keeps Claim and ExplanationOfBenefit active in the core build, while the current core ValueSet files only compose external terminology.hl7.org CodeSystems. Current THO ex-revenue-center contains three generic sample concepts: 0010 Vision Clinic, 0011 Dental Clinic, and 1001 Emergency.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The current core checkout has no local ex-revenue-center CodeSystem concept list to update, and the external current terminology surface already has made-up revenue-center examples.
